title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.8 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 09:56 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 313 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

A broad coronal-hole-like region stands out on an otherwise relatively quiet solar disk.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
